Phase 3 — Figure 7: (1024, 646) QC-GLDPC vs 5G NR LDPC
==========================================================

Generated: 2026-04-10T18:54:47+03:00

Dimension note
--------------
The paper's Fig 7 uses a (1024, 640) QC-GLDPC (rate 0.625). Our Lentmaier (2010)
QC construction with eBCH(32,26) yields (1024, 646) (rate 0.631) because the
QC circulant adjacency structure introduces 6 linearly dependent rows in H.
After review during epic 6efb756b closure, this discrepancy is accepted and
documented: rate 0.631 vs 0.625 is 0.95 % off and has negligible impact on
the headline "GLDPC outperforms LDPC" qualitative result visible in the table
below. Resolving the rank deficiency would require either a modified QC
construction (research effort, uncertain outcome) or a different component
code (out-of-scope scope change), neither of which would materially change
the epic's conclusion.
